description: A blue badge with a transparent surround, blurred by 0.1 of its height, over a red bed. This is the fixture that catches the halo: the badge's transparent pixels carry black, so a blur averaged in straight alpha drags that black into the visible edge and rings the badge in a dark band. Blurred after premultiplying -- which is the order the compositor uses -- the edge is red giving way to blue and nothing darker than either. A dark ring around the badge means the blur ran on the wrong pixels; it is invisible in a diff of numbers and obvious in a frame, which is why this is a golden and not a unit test alone.
